Module unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2
Package unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.data

Class DataModifier

java.lang.Object
unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.data.DataModifier
public class DataModifier extends Object
Handles data management operations such as reading from files, parsing data, and saving receipts. This class provides methods for retrieving vehicle data, rental data, failure data, and receipt information, as well as methods for serialization and deserialization of vehicles.
